title: Orbital period expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be the correct formula: T = 2π √(r³/(GM)).

title: Maximum distance value
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must be the correct numerical multiple of r: 5r.

title: Applying Kepler's Third Law
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply the law (r³/T² = constant) to relate the periods and radii of satellites P and Q.

title: Correct radius for Q
description: Important: From Kepler's Law and T_Q = 8T_P, the student must correctly derive the orbital radius r_Q = 4r.

title: Geometric configuration for max distance
description: Important: The student must recognize that the maximum separation occurs when the satellites are on opposite sides of the Earth along a straight line.

title: Force balance derivation
description: Optional: The solution may show the derivation of the period from equating gravitational force to centripetal force.

title: Algebraic or sign error
description: Pitfall: Penalize incorrect manipulation of Kepler's Law (e.g., r_Q = 2r or 8r) or the distance sum (e.g., 3r or 4r).

title: Missing or incorrect units
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the period answer is given without the 2π factor or if distance is given with incorrect units or dimensions.
